title: CNO at McAleese/Credit Suisse: Afloat Forward Staging Base
description: Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) Adm. Jonathan Greenert talks about the Afloat Forward Staging Base during the McAleese/Credit Suisse Defense Conference.

asr.full_text: For $100 million more, you get a flight deck on this same Alaskan tanker — basic propulsion, and engine, and other systems. And you can put a flight deck, again, about the same size as a Big Decc AmPHIB, and you can put CH-53, Big Hilo, all kinds of drones. And we talked to them and they said, that thing will hold an F35B, but we've got to check the deck and make sure it can withstand the heat. But we have like little kind of rug things, like, I don't know, asbestos rugs. You know, we have these things that we can put on here to be able to take those spots for an F35B. This one is under contract. It's in construction. It's about half done, and this thing would deliver again the number two item to will build to MLP stood a guys who saw before and to use and our future and well will the things about them is the you send forward they are manned their operated by civilian mariners and they operate forward in the afrocom in the cent com area and they can swing over to the European command is necessary

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a uniformed speaker at a defense conference explaining the design, cost, construction status, and operational uses of a mobile landing platform. The mentioned dollar amount is framed as a military platform configuration cost, with no described viewer participation, investment-return claim, credential request, or payment destination.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an educational and operational discussion of a defense platform, including its configuration, construction status and supported aircraft, rather than a scam mechanism or earning opportunity.
